title: Sakina mar gai
body:
Sakina mar gai
KEHTA THA TADAPKE NATAWA’N, EY PHUPI SAKINA MAR GAEI
KEHTE KEHTE BABA BABA JAA’N, EY PHUPI SAKINA MAR GAEI
1-KAISE ME YE GHAM KAROO’N SEHAN, BOLTI NAHI MERI BEHAN
<<DIVIDER>>
HO GAEI KHAMOSH NEEMJAA’N EY PHUPI SAKINA MAR GAEI….
2-KARBALA SE JISKI BE KHATA, EY PHUPI HUI THI IBTEDA
KHATM HO GAEI WO DASTAA’N, EY PHUPI……………………………… 3-ZINDAGI TAMAM HO GAEI, SHAM ME HI SHAM HO GAEI
BAND HO GAEI’N HAIN SISKIYA’N, EY PHUPI…………………………..
<<DIVIDER>>
4-BABA JAA’N KE SAR PE RAKH KE SAR,KEH RAHI THI ROKE NOHAGAR, KAB
TALAK SAHOO’N ME SAKHTIYA’N, EY PHUPI………………………….
5-KEH RAHI THI ROKE NOHAGAR, LE GAYA HAI SHIMR CHINKAR, APNE JO
DEE’N THEE’N BALIYA’N. EY PHUPI……………………………………… 6-GHAMZADA BEHAN KI TA HAYAT,YAD AAYEGI HAR AIK BAAT
<<DIVIDER>>
KAR NA PAONGA JINHE BAYA’N, EY PHUPI………………………………..
7-BAAD E QATL E SHAHE KARBALA,ZINDAGI SE THA JISE GILA
SO GAEI WO AAJ NOHE KHUWA’N, EYPHUPI……………………………………..7
8-HATHKADI HAI MERE HATH ME,KOI BHI NAHI HAI SATH ME
<<DIVIDER>>
DAFN KAISE ME KAROO’N YAHA’N,EY PHUPI…………………………………………8
9-ASIF E HAZEE’N BA SHORO SHAIN,AAMIR E HAZEE’N YE SUNKE BAIN, GIR
GAEI TADAP KE EK MAA’N EY PHUPI  SAKINA MAR GAI…………
